div.head: I Atr 1.8
div.ab: ⁊ gyf mon þone hlaford teo, þæt he be his ræde utthleope ⁊ ær unriht worhte, nime him fif þegnas to ⁊ beo him sylf sixta ⁊ ladie hine þæs.
And gyf mon ðone hlaford teo, þæt he be his hræde uthleope ⁊ ær unriht worhte, nime him fif ðegnas to ⁊ beo him sylf syxta ⁊ ladie hine ðæs.
Et si dominus eius accusetur, quod consilio suo fugerit et antea malum fecerit, assumat secum V tainos et idem sit sextus et ladiet se.
And gyf mon ðone hlaford teo, þæt he be his ræde uthleope ⁊ ær unriht worhte, nime him fif ðegnas to ⁊ beo him sylf syxta ⁊ ladie hine ðæs.
And if the lord is accused of advising the man who had done wrong to escape, he shall choose five thegns, and shall himself make a sixth, and shall clear himself of the accusation.

Und wenn der Herr beschuldigt wird, dass auf seinen Rath jener entflohen sei und früher schon Missethat verübt habe, so wähle er sich fünf Thegnas [als Eideshelfer] und sei selbst Sechster und schwöre sich davon rein.

And if the lord is accused of the man having escaped on his advice and of having already done wrong before, let him take five thegns [as oath-helpers] and be himself the sixth, and clear himself of it.
